label: Deep refresh across all criteria (19 Nov 2026), including AI-generated works
description: Multi-language sweep across every catalog topic, 19 Nov 2026, plus a dedicated search for AI-generated films, shorts, vertical/micro dramas, YouTube/TikTok/Bilibili/Douyin series, AI anime, and AI comics/webtoons. Focus on titles new since the 17 Nov 2026 deep refresh, plus deeper and older titles not yet found, vertical dramas, TikTok/Instagram series, and non-English works. Adults only; non-explicit notes; every entry sourced with a confidence label. AI-generated works are marked in format/meta and tagged AI-generated. This file was created at the start of the run and appended at the true end of SOURCES so existing IDs do not shift.

records.title: The Mummy's Ghost
records.meta: Horror feature · USA · English · Universal Pictures · directed by Reginald LeBorg · Lon Chaney Jr., John Carradine, Ramsay Ames · third sequel to The Mummy's Hand (1940)
records.character: Amina Mansori (a young woman of Egyptian descent, girlfriend of Tom Hervey; living with her guardian Mrs. Blake)
records.summary: In Mapleton, Massachusetts, Amina feels a clouded state of mind whenever Egypt is mentioned. When the high priest Yousef Bey brews tana leaves to summon the mummy Kharis, Amina follows Kharis in a trance-like state, and later wanders hypnotically into the yard where Kharis recognizes her as the reincarnation of Princess Ananka and carries her off. Yousef Bey plans to keep her alive with the tana leaves, which sets Kharis against him; Bey is killed, and Kharis carries the rapidly aging Amina into a swamp, where both sink.
records.hypnotist: Kharis the mummy, summoned by Yousef Bey, High Priest of Arkam
records.method: Supernatural trance linked to her reincarnated soul (tana-leaf ritual)
records.kids_note: No children before; she is unmarried and planning to elope with Tom.
records.pregnant_end_note: No pregnancy; she ages and dies in the swamp at the end.
records.kids_together_note: No children (not a couple; she dies at the end).
records.evidence: Wikipedia plot summary: Amina 'follows Kharis in a trance-like state' and later 'hypnotically wanders into the yard'; she sinks into the swamp with Kharis, rapidly aging. AFI Catalog lists the 1944 Universal release.

records.title: Revenge of the Zombies
records.meta: Horror feature · USA · English · Monogram Pictures · directed by Steve Sekely · John Carradine, Gale Storm, Veda Ann Borg (Lila) · aka The Corpse Vanished
records.character: Lila von Altermann (the scientist's wife, sister of Scott Warrington)
records.summary: In the Louisiana bayou, mad scientist Dr. Max von Altermann murders his wife Lila and revives her as one of the zombies he is creating for a Nazi agent. He keeps her under his control, but Lila begins to show free will, slips away, and finally leads his zombies against him, forcing him into a pool of sinking mud and taking herself with him.
records.hypnotist: Dr. Max Heinrich von Altermann (her husband)
records.method: Revived as a zombie by her husband's experiments and kept under his command
records.kids_note: No children are mentioned for Lila.
records.pregnant_end_note: No pregnancy; she dies with her husband at the end.
records.evidence: Wikipedia plot: Max 'murdered Lila before reviving her' as a zombie; he is alarmed that Lila 'appears to possess free will'; she leads the zombies and forces him into sinking mud, taking herself as well. AFI Catalog lists the 1943 Monogram release, and the film is on Internet Archive.

records.title: Executive Assistant: Iris
records.meta: Comic book series · USA · English · Aspen MLT · created by David Wohl and Eduardo Francisco · part of the Executive Assistant shared universe (expanded 2011)
records.character: Executive Assistants Acteia, Iris, Rose and Violet (adult bodyguard-assassins)
records.summary: Elite bodyguard-assassins called Executive Assistants are turned against the people they serve. Duncan activates a mind-control chip he implanted in Acteia and orders her to kill; Iris and Rose fight while brainwashed; a brainwashed Violet tries to kill her employer under Villone's control; and in 'The Hit List,' Iris realizes she too is under Villone's mind control.
records.pregnant_end_note: No pregnancy storyline in the source.
records.kids_together_note: No couple storyline with the controller.
records.evidence: Mental Block wiki page summarizes the Aspen MLT series: Acteia controlled by Duncan's implanted chip and ordered to kill; brainwashed Iris and Rose; Violet and Iris under Villone's mind control. The assistants are adult professional bodyguards.
